title: FTC gives non-objection to Jamaica Observer and Gleaner Company Joint Venture
text:
FTC gives non-objection to Jamaica Observer and Gleaner Company Joint Venture 
Posted on April 13, 2026 by Shavanne Smith 

The Fair Trading Commission gives its non-objection to the Joint Venture Agreement between Jamaica Observer Limited (“JOL”) and Gleaner Company (Media) Limited (“GCML”).  Click here to read the report. 

Posted in News
